## 简体中文

### 亮点

- 修复从发布快照安装，使生成的 bundle 包可以直接安装。

### 修复

- 安装发布快照时不再要求本地预先存在开发目录结构。

### 验证

- Release 工作流重新构建并发布了各平台 bundle 产物。

- [完整更新记录](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1)

## English

### Highlights

- Fixes installation from release snapshots so generated bundle packages can be installed directly.

### Fixes

- Allows release snapshot installation without requiring a locally staged development layout.

### Verification

- Release workflow rebuilt and published the platform bundle artifacts.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1
